title: Menús y mapa local
description: A pass over the user menu and the local map (src/exploration-ui.ts, src/world-map.ts) late in the story, with every ánima the castle asks for. The local map draws an interior as a plan (each room's floor in its tint, thin walls, windows, doors, furniture, steps, the room Gerard is in lit and named in the footer), a real place as a street map (parks, squares, streets with their names, buildings), and any other place from its grid; Gerard and whoever walks with him are their faces. Personaje shows the worn ánima's level and skills beside the stats; Ánimas, the one under the cursor in full.

steps.eval: const s = window.gerard.story; s.merge(['papagato','papagato-2','papagato-3','papagato-4','anima-universidad','dadaista-2','dadaista-3','anima-marta','sincopante-2','anima-luca','prismatico-2','anima-emilie']); s.xp = { papagato: 2600, dadaista: 1300, sincopante: 700, prismatico: 500, freatica: 100 }; s.equip('gerard', 'papagato'); s.equip('aitor', 'sincopante'); s.wear('gerard', 'papagato');
